flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, utilities/emailutility/EmailService, application-*.properties and cron-schedules-*.properties; furnish_processing/FurnishApprovalHelper (source of the hirer contact). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not used; utilities/emailutility/EmailService
note: Status in stories.json: 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: 'Vault & email Code Split. May need to check if email permission needs to be granted to the api App Service server' (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. A company hirer (idType B, UEN) gets the RD1 email through the same eNotification job as the company owner (OCMS12.5): combined per UEN + stage + due date, sent through EmailService. Findings: (1) application-prod.properties has email.enableSmtp=false and source ENOTIFICATION is not in email.smtp.allowedSources, so EmailService refuses to send in prod; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments; (3) the email text (template RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY) is in the database, not in the repo, and the template name does not distinguish owner and hirer; (4) the latest email from CorpPass DataHive is switched off by the same flag as in OCMS12.22; (5) the combining step is Sebagian because the combined key contains stage and due date, same as OCMS12.20. Note for the parent: OCMS12.5 rates the same combining step Sesuai; the fits should be aligned. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (ENA only, waits for the cron to be activated). Email permission and Vault: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. Combining per UEN and the email sending exist in the code, but email is blocked in prod (enableSmtp=false, ENOTIFICATION not in the allowlist), the cron is inactive, and the template text is not visible in the repo. Ask for evidence of template RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY and confirmation of the prod config.

steps.step: The email address of the company hirer is obtained from DOS (DataHive CorpPass)
steps.detail: refreshCompanyContactInfo reads CP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL from the CorpPass view by UEN, accepts only an ACTIVE account with ACCOUNT_TYPE A01, and saves it through updateOcmsCompanyContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2496-2560, 2676-2698). But refreshContactInfo and batchPreloadContactInfo return immediately unless cron.enareminder.datahive is 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2329, 2468) and the value is false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So the contact already stored in owner_driver is used; for a hirer who came in through furnish that is the contact from the furnish application (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:556-558). Same fit as OCMS12.22 step 2, OCMS12.23 step 1 and OCMS12.5 step 1 (same fact). DOS = DataHive cannot be confirmed from repo; the DataHive/Vault connection cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Unique company hirers (per UEN) are identified and their outstanding notices are combined into one email
steps.detail: combineNotices (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191) groups through getRecipientKey: the individual key is 'I_' + ID number, the company key is 'B_' + UEN (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2230-2245), but the combined key = recipient + stage + paymentDueDate (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2178). The same hirer with notices of a different due date or stage becomes separate groups and can receive more than one message on the same day, while the story asks for one unique recipient per batch. Same fit as OCMS12.19 and OCMS12.20 (same fact). A company with a UEN in the exclusion list is skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-231) and a company without email is rejected by validateContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2275).

steps.step: The email lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 1st letter reminder
steps.detail: For idType B the channel = EMAIL and the template is named RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY or RD1_EMAIL_COMPANY_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-476); subject and body are split through splitEmailTemplate (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:325). The data noticeCount, combinedNotices, amountPayable, paymentDueDate is supplied (410-433), but no code inserts a reference to the 1st letter; the text is in ocms_template_store (database), not in the repo, so cannot verify from repo. A missing template means the email is skipped with a log (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:378-392). Stages DN1, DN2, DR3 get no company email because the template is missing (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-317), but RD1 is not among them. The template is chosen by the name <stage>_<channel>_<recipient type> (determineTemplateName) with no owner/hirer/driver role dimension, so an owner and a hirer at the same stage use the same template; whether the wording suits a hirer cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The email is sent to the company hirer in the batch job and the result is recorded
steps.detail: The job calls notificationHelper.sendEmail per company record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:378-392), which uses EmailService with source ENOTIFICATION (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:556-590), and saveSendStatus records the result (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:396). But EmailService.sendEmail refuses to send when email.enableSmtp=false and the source is not in email.smtp.allowedSources (EmailService.java:65-73): prod has enableSmtp=false and ENOTIFICATION is not in the allowlist (application-prod.properties:80-81); uat allows ENOTIFICATION (application-uat.properties:78-79); dev has enableSmtp=true (application-dev.properties:81). The daily cron is enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; NotificationJobsScheduler.java:42-55). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 waits for the eNotification cron to be activated. SMTP permission from the App Service and the real server property values cannot verify from repo.
